For grown-ups: Andika has a single-storey a and g, and an l with a tail, so letters are not mixed up.

Settings

Display
Grandstander OFL · titles and buttons
Text
Andika OFL · reading text; letter shapes drawn for early readers
Moves
airy setting, reading-first text face, rounded display
Mood
warm, encouraging, playful, clear
Case
Sentence case only. Never all capitals for children: word shapes are how they read.
Numerals and features
font-variant-ligatures: none; letter-spacing: 0.01em

a g l I 1 · fly firsta g l I 1 · fly first

Ligatures off and a hair of tracking keep each letter separate for early readers.
Signature
The story text is the largest reading size on the screen (28 px, line height 1.7), and the word being read aloud gets a thick orange underline that moves word by word.
Use when
Reading and learning apps, children’s books online, school tools for ages four to nine.
Turns into slop when
When the rounded display face sets paragraphs, when every element bounces, or when text is set on a busy illustration.
Offline
Without network the page falls back to the system stacks in --f-display and --f-text; no font files ship with this specimen.
